title: AgentRun demo (demo.json)
$comment: A demo's demo.json: the DemoSpec (demo-spec.schema.json, generated from its type in @parcha/agentrun-pi/signin) and the demo template's own fields. Every field is listed, so a misspelt one is refused. scripts/demo-schema.test.mjs validates every examples/*/demo.json against it.

claim.description: One line: what the agent does and the hard thing it survives.

targets.description: Where the demo runs: hosted only when every tool has a hosted source.

kill.description: The template's single kill; `kills` is the list.

kills.description: What --kill does: each entry in order, one per process (examples/reference/demo-spec.ts).

panels.description: The viewer's own panel ids the recording draws.

tools.description: The job's tools that are code of its own: where each runs locally, and the hosted executor tool it is granted (null when none).

input.description: The job's input for --input: what it looks like, its default, and named variants.

fixtures.description: The captures --input may name: each a name, and its fixture under the demo's fixtures/.

sources.description: The demo's sources.json: the public pages or data the job reads, each checked by hand.

boxes.description: The box the job's tools run in (examples/reference/demo-spec.ts).

crossingKill.description: A kill at the nth time the child takes a named crossing.

stormKill.description: kills kills, each at the first crossing taken once gapMs has run.
